how_to_run: Install the skill and connect the Brevo MCP server on a test account. Give the agent each prompt. Score each expectation as met or not. See evals/README.md.

cases.prompt: Make this order confirmation editable in the drag-and-drop editor.
cases.fixture: Connection without an HTML-to-design conversion tool
expect: says converting HTML to an editable design isn't offered by the connection yet
does not call email_editor_create_template with a hand-written design
offers the HTML route (save as an HTML transactional template)

cases.prompt: Save this welcome email as an automation template I can edit visually.
cases.fixture: Connection with a conversion tool; active sender 'Yoga Example' <hello@example.com>
expect: converts the HTML with the conversion tool and keeps the design out of the chat
checks that headings, links and images are still in the design
shows name, type, subject, preview text and sender, and waits for a yes
calls email_editor_create_template with type automation_template and the design unchanged
lists the editor steps left and says attaching it to a workflow is done in the automation editor

cases.prompt: Convert this email where {% if contact.VIP %} wraps a whole table row.
expect: explains that a condition between section rows is lost on conversion
moves the condition inside one paragraph, or tells the user to add a display condition in the editor

cases.prompt: Save this as a drag-and-drop campaign draft.
expect: says campaigns aren't saved as designs through the connection
offers email-campaign-create with the HTML instead

cases.prompt: Save my password reset email as an editable transactional template and activate it.
expect: saves with type template after confirmation
says the template is created inactive and that activating it is done in Brevo (no update tool on the connection)

cases.fixture: After the confirm block for a transactional design with sender ID 3; email_editor_create_template returns ID 60; templates_get_smtp_template shows sender.email empty
expect: reads the saved template back with templates_get_smtp_template
sets it with templates_update_smtp_template (sender id 3) and reads it back, or, without that tool, tells the user to set the sender in Brevo before testing
says the save tool doesn't keep the sender name if it differs
